dashboard.description: Origin cost and cache efficiency posture. L0 cache-miss and TTFB deltas, L1 endpoint cost ranking and ASN concentration, L2 cache-thrash and querystring churn evidence.

options.content:
Bot Insights -- Edge/Ops
Origin cost and cache efficiency posture. Identify expensive endpoints, cache thrash, and ASN concentration risk.
Data Freshness: ${data_freshness}

panels.description: Cache hit rate (cached / total) over time. Solid line = current window. Dashed line = baseline (preceding window of equal length).

targets.rawSql:
WITH duration AS (
  SELECT greatest(dateDiff('second', toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}), toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})), 1) AS secs
)
SELECT
  cur.time,
  cur.cache_hit_rate,
  base.cache_hit_rate AS baseline_cache_hit_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    least(countIfMerge(`countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, true))`) * 100.0 / greatest(countIfMerge(`countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, true))`) + countIfMerge(`countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, false))`), 1), 100) AS cache_hit_rate
  FROM ${summary_table}
  WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
    AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
    AND $__adHocFilter()
    AND ('${site}' = '$__all' OR request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}))
    AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
    AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:singlequote}), $client_asn)
    AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:singlequote}), $bot_class)
  GROUP BY time
) cur
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    timestamp + INTERVAL ${duration} MINUTE AS time,
    least(countIfMerge(`countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, true))`) * 100.0 / greatest(countIfMerge(`countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, true))`) + countIfMerge(`countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, false))`), 1), 100) AS cache_hit_rate
  FROM ${summary_table}
  WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL ${duration} MINUTE
    AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
    AND $__adHocFilter()
    AND ('${site}' = '$__all' OR request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}))
    AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
    AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:singlequote}), $client_asn)
    AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:singlequote}), $bot_class)
  GROUP BY time
) base ON cur.time = base.time
ORDER BY cur.time
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Cache efficiency trend; du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: Endpoints ranked by origin cost proxy: ~p95(origin_ttfb) x request_count under the active site, traffic, ASN, and cohort filters.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  request_path_norm,
  count() * $scale_factor AS vol,
  ifNull(quantileTDigest(0.95)(origin_time_to_first_byte_ms), 0) AS p95_origin_ms,
  count() * ifNull(quantileTDigest(0.95)(origin_time_to_first_byte_ms), 0) / 1000 AS cost_proxy,
  least(countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, false)) * 100.0 / greatest(countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, false)) + countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, true)), 1), 100) AS cache_miss_pct
FROM ${raw_table}
WHERE reqTimeSec >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND reqTimeSec <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND ('${site}' = '$__all' OR request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}))
  AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:singlequote}), $client_asn)
  AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:singlequote}), $bot_class)
  AND notEmpty(request_path_norm)
GROUP BY request_path_norm
ORDER BY cost_proxy DESC
LIMIT 50
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top endpoints by origin cost; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Top Endpoints by Origin Cost (p95 x Volume)

panels.description: Weighted-average origin TTFB by best-available traffic cohort. When Akamai SIEM categorization is authoritative and meets threshold, rows use SIEM bot_category with source metadata; otherwise they fall back to UA-derived bot_class.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  ua_counts AS (
    SELECT
      bot_class AS class_key,
      is_bot_traffic,
      countMerge(`count()`) AS volume,
      avgMerge(`avg(origin_time_to_first_byte_ms)`) * countMerge(`count()`) AS ttfb_weighted,
      countIfMerge(`countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, false))`) AS cache_misses
    FROM ${summary_table}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
      AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
      AND $__adHocFilter()
      AND ('${site}' = '$__all' OR request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}))
      AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:singlequote}), $client_asn)
      AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:singlequote}), $bot_class)
    GROUP BY bot_class, is_bot_traffic
  ),
  siem_counts AS (
    SELECT
      class_key,
      siem_bot_category,
      siem_bot_category_source,
      siem_bot_type,
      sum(volume) AS volume,
      sum(ttfb_weighted) AS ttfb_weighted,
      sum(cache_misses) AS cache_misses
    FROM (
      SELECT
        akamai_canonical_bot_class AS class_key,
        bot_category AS siem_bot_category,
        bot_category_source AS siem_bot_category_source,
        bot_type AS siem_bot_type,
        cnt_all AS volume,
        avg_origin_ttfb * cnt_all AS ttfb_weighted,
        cnt_cache_miss AS cache_misses
      FROM ${siem_class_summary_table}
      WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
        AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
        AND ('${site}' = '$__all' OR request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}))
        AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:singlequote}), $client_asn)
        AND notEmpty(bot_category)
      AND $__conditionalAll(akamai_canonical_bot_class IN (${bot_class_siem:singlequote}), $bot_class_siem)
      GROUP BY class_key, siem_bot_category, siem_bot_category_source, siem_bot_type
    )
    GROUP BY class_key, siem_bot_category, siem_bot_category_source, siem_bot_type
  ),
  traffic_total AS (
    SELECT coalesce(sum(volume), 0) AS total FROM ua_counts
  ),
  siem_evidence AS (
    SELECT
      coalesce(sum(volume), 0) AS siem_event_count,
      coalesce(sum(volume) / nullIf((SELECT total FROM traffic_total), 0), 0) AS siem_coverage_pct
    FROM siem_counts
  ),
  siem_threshold AS (
    SELECT
      siem_event_count,
      siem_coverage_pct,
      if(siem_event_count >= 20 OR siem_coverage_pct >= 0.05, 1, 0) AS meets_threshold
    FROM siem_evidence
  ),
  use_siem AS (
    SELECT if(
      '${classification_policy}' = 'akamai_authoritative'
      AND '${has_akamai_siem}' = '1'
      AND '${traffic_type}' IN ('all', 'bot')
      AND (SELECT meets_threshold FROM siem_threshold) = 1,
      1, 0
    ) AS flag
  )
SELECT
  cohort,
  canonical_bot_class,
  canonical_bot_class_source,
  canonical_bot_class_confidence,
  siem_bot_category,
  siem_bot_category_source,
  siem_bot_type,
  siem_event_count,
  siem_coverage_pct,
  total_requests,
  weighted_avg_origin_ttfb_ms,
  cache_miss_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    multiIf(
      is_bot_traffic = 0, 'Legitimate Browser',
      class_key = 'search_bot', 'Search Bot',
      class_key = 'ai_data_scraper', 'AI Data Scraper',
      class_key = 'ai_assistant', 'AI Assistant',
      class_key = 'ai_search_crawler', 'AI Search Crawler',
      class_key = 'crawler', 'Crawler',
      class_key = 'http_library', 'HTTP Library',
      class_key = 'social_media_agent', 'Social Media Agent',
      class_key = 'validator', 'Validator',
      class_key
    ) AS cohort,
    multiIf(
      max(is_bot_traffic) = 0, 'human',
      argMax(class_key, volume)
    ) AS canonical_bot_class,
    'ua_dict' AS canonical_bot_class_source,
    'derived' AS canonical_bot_class_confidence,
    '' AS siem_bot_category,
    '' AS siem_bot_category_source,
    '' AS siem_bot_type,
    (SELECT siem_event_count FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_event_count,
    (SELECT siem_coverage_pct FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_coverage_pct,
    sum(volume) AS total_requests,
    sum(ttfb_weighted) / greatest(sum(volume), 1) AS weighted_avg_origin_ttfb_ms,
    least(sum(cache_misses) * 100.0 / greatest(sum(volume), 1), 100) AS cache_miss_rate
  FROM ua_counts
  WHERE (SELECT flag FROM use_siem) = 0
  GROUP BY cohort

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    siem_bot_category AS cohort,
    class_key AS canonical_bot_class,
    'akamai_siem' AS canonical_bot_class_source,
    'authoritative' AS canonical_bot_class_confidence,
    siem_bot_category,
    siem_bot_category_source,
    siem_bot_type,
    (SELECT siem_event_count FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_event_count,
    (SELECT siem_coverage_pct FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_coverage_pct,
    sum(volume) AS total_requests,
    sum(ttfb_weighted) / greatest(sum(volume), 1) AS weighted_avg_origin_ttfb_ms,
    least(sum(cache_misses) * 100.0 / greatest(sum(volume), 1), 100) AS cache_miss_rate
  FROM siem_counts
  WHERE (SELECT flag FROM use_siem) = 1
  GROUP BY cohort, canonical_bot_class, siem_bot_category, siem_bot_category_source, siem_bot_type
)
ORDER BY weighted_avg_origin_ttfb_ms DESC
LIMIT 50
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Origin latency by canonical cohort; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Origin Latency by Cohort

panels.description: Top ASNs by traffic share. Any ASN exceeding 40% share is flagged HIGH risk. Gradient gauge on share column.

links.title: Drill to What Changed with ASN filter

targets.rawSql:
WITH
    asn_base AS (
      SELECT
        client_asn,
        countMerge(`count()`) AS vol,
        countIfMerge(`countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, false))`) AS cache_misses
      FROM ${summary_table}
      WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
        AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
        AND $__adHocFilter()
        AND ('${site}' = '$__all' OR request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}))
        AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
        AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:singlequote}), $client_asn)
        AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:singlequote}), $bot_class)
      GROUP BY client_asn
    ),
    totals AS (
      SELECT sum(vol) AS total_vol FROM asn_base
    ),
    asn_ttfb AS (
      SELECT
        client_asn,
        round(avg(origin_time_to_first_byte_ms), 1) AS avg_ttfb_ms
      FROM ${raw_table}
      WHERE reqTimeSec >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
        AND reqTimeSec <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
        AND $__adHocFilter()
        AND ('${site}' = '$__all' OR request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}))
        AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
        AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:singlequote}), $client_asn)
        AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:singlequote}), $bot_class)
      GROUP BY client_asn
    )
  SELECT
    a.client_asn,
    a.vol,
    round(a.vol / greatest((SELECT total_vol FROM totals), 1) * 100, 1) AS vol_share_pct,
    round(a.cache_misses * 100.0 / greatest(a.vol, 1), 1) AS cache_miss_rate,
    t.avg_ttfb_ms,
    round(a.cache_misses * 100.0 / greatest(a.vol, 1) * a.vol / greatest((SELECT total_vol FROM totals), 1), 2) AS risk
  FROM asn_base AS a
  LEFT JOIN asn_ttfb AS t ON a.client_asn = t.client_asn
  ORDER BY risk DESC
  LIMIT 50
  SETTINGS
    hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
    hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Concentration risk (top ASN share); du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: ASN Concentration Risk

panels.description: Cache miss patterns per cohort + endpoint. High unique-QS count with high miss rate = cache thrashing. Requires at least one dimension filter.

defaults.noValue: Select a dimension filter ($client_asn or $bot_class) to activate this panel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  request_path_norm,
  if(bot_class = '', 'Unknown', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(w -> concat(upper(substring(w, 1, 1)), substring(w, 2)), splitByChar('_', assumeNotNull(bot_class))), ' ')) AS cohort,
  countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, false)) AS cache_miss_count,
  countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, true)) AS cache_hit_count,
  least(countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, false)) * 100.0 / greatest(count(), 1), 100) AS cache_miss_rate,
  uniq(request_query_string) AS unique_qs,
  countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, false)) * 1.0 / greatest(count(), 1) * uniq(request_query_string) / greatest(count(), 1) AS thrash_score
FROM ${raw_table}
WHERE reqTimeSec >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND reqTimeSec <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND ('${site}' = '$__all' OR request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}))
  AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:singlequote}), $client_asn)
  AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:singlequote}), $bot_class)
  AND notEmpty(request_path_norm)
GROUP BY request_path_norm, bot_class
ORDER BY thrash_score DESC
LIMIT 50
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Cache thrash by cohort + endpoint; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Cache Thrash by Cohort + Endpoint

panels.description: Unique querystring patterns per path. High churn = potential cache-busting behavior. Requires dimension filter.

defaults.noValue: Select a dimension filter to activate this panel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  request_path_norm,
  uniq(request_query_string) AS unique_qs,
  count() * $scale_factor AS total,
  uniq(request_query_string) / greatest(count(), 1) AS churn_ratio,
  round(uniq(request_query_string) / greatest(count(), 1) * 100, 1) AS churn_score,
  log2(greatest(uniq(request_query_string), 1)) AS qs_entropy_approx
FROM ${raw_table}
WHERE reqTimeSec >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND reqTimeSec <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND ('${site}' = '$__all' OR request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}))
  AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:singlequote}), $client_asn)
  AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:singlequote}), $bot_class)
  AND notEmpty(request_path_norm)
GROUP BY request_path_norm
ORDER BY unique_qs DESC
LIMIT 50
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Querystring churn indicator; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Querystring Churn Indicator

panels.description: How WAF enforcement actions (block, rate_limit, challenge) correlate with cache miss rates. Requires SIEM data source.

targets.rawSql:
-- WAF Action Impact [+SIEM] - routed to raw SIEM for filter-safe grouping
SELECT
  action_taken,
  count() * $scale_factor AS total,
  countIf(or(equals(action_taken, 'deny'), equals(action_taken, 'block'))) AS blocked,
  countIf(and(greaterOrEquals(toUInt16(response_status_code), 400), less(toUInt16(response_status_code), 500))) AS client_errors,
  countIf(greaterOrEquals(toUInt16(response_status_code), 500)) AS server_errors,
  round(countIf(and(greaterOrEquals(toUInt16(response_status_code), 400), less(toUInt16(response_status_code), 500))) * 100.0 / greatest(count(), 1), 1) AS error_pct,
  round(countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, false)) * 100.0 / greatest(count(), 1), 1) AS cache_miss_pct
FROM ${siem_raw_table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND ('${site}' = '$__all' OR request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}))
  AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:singlequote}), $client_asn)
  AND notEmpty(action_taken)
  AND '${siem_available}' = '1'
GROUP BY action_taken
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 100
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=WAF action impact (raw siem); du=${__user.login}'

  uniq(client_ip) AS unique_ips,

  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})

  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:singlequote}), $client_asn)
  AND notEmpty(policy_id)
  AND '${siem_available}' = '1'
GROUP BY policy_id

panels.title: Origin Cost by Policy ID [+SIEM]

panels.description: Individual request records scoped by active filters. LIMIT 500, 8 rows per page, ORDER BY timestamp DESC.

defaults.noValue: Apply a filter to view raw logs

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  reqTimeSec AS timestamp,
  client_ip,
  client_asn,
  bot_class,
  user_agent_category,
  request_method,
  request_host,
  request_path,
  request_query_string,
  response_status_code,
  cache_was_cached,
  origin_time_to_first_byte_ms,
  response_total_bytes
FROM ${raw_table}
WHERE reqTimeSec >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND reqTimeSec <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND ('${site}' = '$__all' OR request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}))
  AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:singlequote}), $client_asn)
  AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:singlequote}), $bot_class)
  AND (('${client_asn:text}' <> 'All' OR '${bot_class:text}' <> 'All') OR (reqTimeSec < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND reqTimeSec >= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})))
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 500
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Raw logs scoped evidence; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: ▶ Raw Logs - Scoped Evidence

list.name: duration
list.query: SELECT greatest(dateDiff('minute', toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}), toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})), 1) AS duration

list.label: Site
list.name: site
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT request_host FROM ${agg_table} WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY request_host LIMIT 1000

list.label: ASN
list.name: client_asn
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT client_asn FROM ${agg_asn_table} WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${site}' = '$__all' OR request_host IN (${site:sqlstring})) ORDER BY client_asn LIMIT 1000

list.label: Cohort
list.name: bot_class
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT bot_class FROM ${summary_table} WHERE ('${site}' = '$__all' OR request_host IN (${site:sqlstring})) ORDER BY bot_class LIMIT 1000

list.name: bot_class_siem
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT multiIf(bot_class = 'search_bot', 'seo_crawler', bot_class IN ('ai_data_scraper', 'ai_assistant', 'ai_search_crawler'), 'ai_crawler', bot_class = 'crawler', 'scraper', bot_class = 'social_media_agent', 'social_crawler', bot_class = 'validator', 'monitoring_bot', bot_class = 'http_library', 'unknown_bot', bot_class) AS bot_class_siem FROM ${summary_table} WHERE ('${site}' = '$__all' OR request_host IN (${site:sqlstring})) AND is_bot_traffic = true AND notEmpty(bot_class) AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:singlequote}), $bot_class) ORDER BY bot_class_siem LIMIT 1000

list.name: siem_available
list.query: SELECT if(count() > 0, '1', '0') AS has_siem FROM (SELECT 1 FROM ${siem_raw_table} LIMIT 1)

list.name: has_akamai_siem
list.query: SELECT if(count() > 0, '1', '0') AS has_siem FROM (SELECT 1 FROM ${siem_class_summary_table} WHERE notEmpty(bot_category) LIMIT 1)

list.name: data_freshness
list.query: SELECT concat(coalesce(hdx_cdn, 'default'), ': ', multiIf(dateDiff('minute', max(timestamp), toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})) < 30, '✅', dateDiff('minute', max(timestamp), toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})) < 120, '⚠️', '🔴'), ' (', toString(dateDiff('minute', max(timestamp), toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds}))), 'm)') FROM ${summary_minute} WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY coalesce(hdx_cdn, 'default') ORDER BY 1
